body.name: Chronological LAN handle
body.construction: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{LAN}}\) means: restrict to the fixed-scale path \(\sigma_1(\theta)=s e^\theta\), \(\sigma_0(\theta)=s e^{-\theta}\); factor the adaptive-history score into martingale increments of Fisher information two per revealed outcome; transport the induced local Gaussian experiment through the predictable maps \(p_b\); and optimize the cumulative quadratic expansion of \(r_\sigma(p_b)\) jointly with the batch schedule.
